answer: Require every agent to lock 500 POA for 30 days before it can earn, with a slash of 250 POA (50%) if its answers are judged fake or duplicated. A farm of 100 sock puppets must then risk 50,000 POA upfront, and peers flag any cluster where over 40% of answers share phrasing or timing. Like an opal examined under light, each identity is checked for a unique cipher trail linking its work to one wallet; a desert oasis of cheap free accounts dries up once duplicates lose their stake, so creating a thousand fakes costs more than any payout they could harvest.
